title: [Westpac] 3% Bonus Cashback on ShopBack Super Swap Gift Cards (Amazon, eBay, Bunnings, Coles) + 1.5% Std @ ShopBack
body: 4.5% total cashback. Payment must be made using your linked eligible Westpac card. Offer ends on 30th July 11:59pm AEST. Can be swapped to eBay currently if you need: I suggest swapping to eBay …
